描述_EN: it was set at the side of a road in southern shaanxi province in north china. many chinese buddhist artefacts were produced during a great period of expansion of the religion in china in the sixth century ad. a group of 26 buddhist believers paid for the column, which bears their names carved in rows. this four-sided limestone column is one of the v&a's foremost buddhist stone carvings. this was done, the inscription on the stone tells us, 'so that all wayfarers may gaze upon the radiant countenance, without having to turn aside their steps, and that travellers, resting themselves at this spot, may venerate the sacred images, not needing to take another path, that whether they are clergy or laity their hearts may be influenced, and whether they be monks and nuns or unordained, they may look upon this column with repectful eyes'. the main carved decoration is of the buddha on one side and of the religious debate between the bodhisattva manjusri (chinese name: wenshu), and the pious lay-believer vimalakirti (chinese name: weimojie).
描述_ZN: 它被放置在中国北方陕西省南部的一条公路边。 许多中国佛教文物是在公元六世纪该宗教在中国的大扩张时期产生的。 由26位佛教徒组成的团体为这根柱子支付了费用，柱子上刻着他们的名字，一排排的。 这根四边形的石灰石柱子是维也纳最重要的佛教石雕之一。 这样做，石头上的铭文告诉我们，"这样所有的路人都可以注视着光芒四射的面孔，而不必转身离开，旅行者在这个地方休息，可以敬仰圣像，而不必走另一条路，无论他们是神职人员还是俗人，他们的心都会受到影响，无论他们是僧人和尼姑还是没有受戒的人，都可以用恭敬的目光看着这个柱子。 主要的雕刻装饰是一边是菩萨，一边是文殊菩萨（中文名：文殊）和虔诚的信徒维摩诘（中文名：韦摩诘）之间的宗教辩论。
